title: WinTogether
tagline: WinTogether is an AI-powered guaranteed-prize lottery system. 🎟️ Gift a ticket to a friend, and they’ll always win something! Powered by smart contracts on Base and AI agents via Autonome + AgentKit. 🚀
description:
WinTogether is a next-generation on-chain lottery system where every ticket is a guaranteed winner! Unlike traditional lotteries, where most participants lose their money, WinTogether ensures that every ticket has a prize—typically less than the ticket cost, but always something in return.

Lotteries are fun but unfair—most participants lose everything. WinTogether revolutionizes the lottery experience by ensuring that every ticket wins something, and AI handles all the complexities, making participation effortless!

Gifting someone a lottery ticket that is guaranteed to win is more than just a fun surprise—it’s a unique way to provide excitement, hope, and a small financial reward while also making crypto gifting more engaging and accessible.
how_its_made: WinTogether is a guaranteed-prize lottery built on Base L2, where every ticket wins something, eliminating the traditional "all-or-nothing" risk of lotteries. The project was successfully developed with Ethereum smart contracts, a Next.js frontend, and Thirdweb SDK integration, allowing users to buy tickets, check their winnings, and claim prizes seamlessly. The original plan included AI-powered automation using Autonome AI Agents and Coinbase AgentKit, which would have enabled automated ticket purchases, prize tracking, and AI-driven optimal lottery participation. With Autonome, AI agents would have bought tickets on behalf of users, monitored winnings, and auto-claimed prizes, making participation effortless. Coinbase AgentKit would have introduced gasless transactions and smart accounts, allowing AI to execute on-chain actions autonomously, enabling wallet-free and frictionless lottery engagement. While the core lottery functionality is fully implemented, the AI-powered automation was planned but not integrated, meaning users must currently interact with the contract manually. However, adding AI would elevate WinTogether into a fully autonomous, AI-driven lottery experience, making it one of the most innovative uses of blockchain and agentic AI in Web3 gaming.
